income_reversal.note: annual_inc alone reverses clearly (SHAP rises from -0.237 at $90-110K back toward -0.14 at $500K+). Grouped with loan_to_income and revol_bal_to_income (both scaled by the same income), the combined effect mostly plateaus around -0.25 to -0.27 rather than trending back toward zero - the other income-scaled features partly offset annual_inc's own reversal, since a very high earner's loan_to_income and revol_bal_to_income are mechanically very low.

dti_dip.note: Both the SHAP dip and the raw train default rate dip in the dti=3-8 region before rising.
